scoring_justification: Direct comparison of agent's output scalars against paper-reported reference values with tolerances; recomputation from raw wavefunctions is too heavy for the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for band gap and SHG coefficients
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper main text and figures: Kohn-Sham band gap 2.58 eV from text and Fig. S12; powder SHG ABSI 1.81 pm/V from text and Fig. 3; d22=2.87 pm/V from text; SHG ABI 1.27 pm/V from text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's explicitly stated computed values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the source paper's DFT section.

outputs.description: Kohn-Sham band gap of ABSI computed from DFT band structure.
Powder-averaged second harmonic generation coefficient for ABSI.
The d22 component of the SHG tensor for ABSI.
Powder-averaged second harmonic generation coefficient for the parent compound ABI.

output_contract.notes: All four outputs are single floating-point numbers in plain text. The hidden checker compares each to the paper-reported value within a tolerance, and additionally verifies that the ABSI powder SHG is greater than the ABI powder SHG. The verifier does not need to recompute the values; it reads the submitted text files directly.

steps.description: Check that Kohn-Sham band gap is within tolerance of paper's computed 2.58 eV.
Verify that powder SHG for ABSI is greater than ABI.
